[[Union Douala]] (16) |longest winless = [[Tonnerre Yaoundé|Tonnerre]] (16) |longest losses = [[Tonnerre Yaoundé|Tonnerre]] (7) |prevseason = [[2014 Elite One|2014]] |nextseason = [[2016 Elite One|2016]] }} The '''2015 [[Elite One]]''' was the 55th season of the Cameroon Top League. The season began on 8 February 2015. [[Coton Sport FC de Garoua|Cotonsport]] won their third consecutive title and 14th overall, all in the last 19 years. [[Coton Sport FC de Garoua|Cotonsport]] clinched the title in the final round of the season, holding onto their 1-point lead over [[Union Douala]] when both teams closed the season with a draw. Union Douala picked up a road point with a 1-1 score at [[New Star de Douala|New Star]], while Cotonsport played a scoreless home tie against [[Botafogo FC (Douala)|Botafogo FC]]. With their respective top-two finishes, Cotonsport and Union Douala qualified for the [[2016 CAF Champions League]]. New Star and Botafogo finished in a third-place tie and will play a play-off to determine the [[2016 CAF Confederation Cup]] qualifier. [[Canon Yaoundé|Canon]], [[Njala Quan Sports Academy|Njala Quan]] and [[Tonnerre Yaoundé|Tonnerre]] finished 16th, 17th and 18th, respectively and will be relegated to [[Elite Two]] for the 2016 season. While there was no doubt about the fates of Njala Quan and Tonnerre, Canon could have escaped relegation with a win in their final game, but played [[Cosmos de Bafia]] to a 1-1 draw on the road to seal their fate. ==Teams locations== {{Location map+ |Cameroon |width=525 |float=right |caption=Locations of the 2014 Elite One teams |places= {{Location map~ |Cameroon |lat=3.885481 |long=11.540607 |label=[[APEJES Academy|APEJES]]
